天界时序紊，凡尘夙契深
九天之上，有时序神域，亘古寂然，无四时之替，无昼夜之更，无生老之轮回，惟存天道时序之则，以纲维三界万物，定岁月之流转。域中有殿，名曰时序，无梁无柱，巍然凌霄。殿中悬一玉璧，通体莹洁，号时序玉璧，上有日月星辰旋走，年月日时循序而行，光影一动，即应凡尘朝夕之变、世间岁月之迁。
掌此神域、司三界时序者，乃天界三正神：年神何年、月神何月、日神何日。
三神本混沌初开之时，天地时序精气所化，生于神域，无父无母，相依相守，以守时序、护玉璧为天职，历千万载，未尝有分毫之失。三界诸神咸谓：年月日三神，性虽殊异，心则相通，共掌时序，和而无隙，诚天界之良神也。
年神何年，为三神之长，司年岁更迭、四季轮回、甲子推移。其神姿挺拔，衣素白之袍，眉目间蕴万古沉凝之气，性内敛，言寡慎，心思缜密，行止守矩，一丝不苟。千万载间，坐守玉璧，定年岁起止，观凡尘王朝兴替、生灵生灭，心如止水，不喜不悲，宛若旧岁流年，涵容世间沧桑。其手执年岁权杖，杖刻天干地支，轻挥则定年岁、转轮回，为神域至厚之力。
月神何月，三神之中唯一女仙，司月相盈亏、潮汐涨落、夜色昏明。其貌绝美，眉如远黛，目若秋水，衣月白之裙，周身月华萦绕。性如明月，阴晴无定，或温婉柔善，或清冷淡然，或娇憨执拗。心慕凡尘月色，常倚殿侧云栏，俯瞰人间月下烟火，念念向往。然天规森严，时序之神，不得擅离职守，不得干乱凡尘时序，不得生贪恋凡尘之念，只得藏心于内，未敢稍泄。其肩覆月华绫罗，可聚月华、定月相，使明月盈亏有序，长夜安宁。
日神何日，为三神之幼，司日出日落、昼夜更替、阳气流转。衣炽金短褐，眉目张扬，笑意朗然，周身日光灼灼。性烈如火，爽朗率直，如朝阳初升，炽烈难掩，不知收敛。难耐神域孤寂，常思冲破九天，游遍三界，观凡尘日出东方、日薄西山，沐人间烟火。每为年神所诫，辄嬉皮谢过，旋即复故，仗幼蒙兄姊纵容，性益跳脱。其手执日光灵珠，可引骄阳、定白昼，使昼夜分明，阳气畅达。
千万载以来，三神各司其司：何年掌岁，何月掌月，何日掌日，相辅而行，缺一不可。时序玉璧莹洁如初，三界时序井然，未尝有紊。玉帝及诸天众神，无不嘉许，目为天界最守规、堪重任之神。
孰料万古安宁，一朝尽破。
一日，九天清朗，时序井然，忽风云骤变，天地变色。
时序殿中，素常安稳之玉璧，骤然剧震，莹洁之身，倏生墨色裂痕，璧上年月日时光影大乱，岁时舛错，月相颠倒，昼夜混淆，三界时序，顷刻崩颓。
凡尘由此大扰：当春而暖，忽降冰雪；当望之夜，黯无月华；当昼之时，夜幕长垂；或一方一日历四季，或一处岁月停驻不行。凡间生灵惶惶，哀鸣遍野，戾气冲霄，惊动天庭。
玉帝震怒，即率诸神，亲临时序神域，查乱象之源。
诸仙聚力探察，须臾得悉：乃时序三神，一念疏怠，违犯天规，私触时序玉璧，乱时序之本源，以致三界崩乱，生灵涂炭。
盖前日，何日难耐神域寂寂，见凡尘百姓沐日光而安乐，笑语喧然，心益向往，遂缠何月，欲私动玉璧，延凡尘白昼，使百姓多沐暖阳。何月本心存凡尘之念，为何日软语相求，意遂动而许之。
何年初力阻之，深知天规不可犯，时序不可乱，然见弟妹殷殷期盼之态，念千万载共守神域，无半分自由，心终软，未加峻拒，默许之。
及三神指尖同触玉璧，天地时序之气骤乱，玉璧本源受扰，万古稳固之序，一朝崩坏，酿成滔天大祸。
此虽非三神刻意为之，然因一己私情，藐视天规，终致此劫，罪责难辞。
玉帝端坐云辇，面色沉厉，威声彻神域：“大胆何年、何月、何日！汝三人掌三界时序，身负天道重责，千万载恪尽职守，竟敢徇一己私情，私触玉璧，乱三界时序，害凡尘生灵，触犯天条，罪无可赦！”

诸神屏息，莫敢进言。盖天规之中，时序乃三界之本，乱时序者，为弥天大罪，虽司职正神，难逃重罚。
何年、何月、何日，面色惨白，跪拜玉璧之前，满心愧悔。
三人未料，一时心软任性，竟酿此大祸，累苍生受苦，乱三界秩序，悔之无及。
“陛下，”何年率先叩首，声稳而含愧，“此罪皆在臣。臣为长，不能约束弟妹，复心软纵容，致乱时序，愿一身担其咎，乞陛下宽赦弟妹。”
“兄长！”何日急声而泣，往日张扬尽敛，满面自责，“此非兄长之过，乃弟任性，缠姐触璧，罪在弟身，愿伏重罚！”
“不然，”何月敛容而起，周身月华纷乱，神色决然，“妾先动凡尘之念，应弟之求，罪亦与共，愿与兄弟同受责罚，无敢苟免。”
三神争相认罪，不愿独生，千万载相依之情，于此尽显。
玉帝视三人，目露复杂之态。深知三神本性纯良，非奸邪之辈，千万载守序有功，此番非有心为恶，然罪责滔天，不惩无以服诸神，无以平天道之怒。
沉吟良久，玉帝沉声宣旨：“天道无私，赏罚分明。何年、何月、何日，违犯天条，乱三界时序，本当废仙骨、堕九幽，永世无生。念其千万载守序有功，且非蓄意作乱，法外开恩，从轻发落。”
稍顿，目光肃然，定其责罚：“朕今降旨，夺汝三人时序神位，废周身仙法，碎神识记忆，贬入凡尘轮回，投生凡俗之家，为骨肉血亲，历凡尘生老病死、爱恨嗔痴、悲欢离合之苦。”
“汝凡尘历劫之际，需寻回破碎之时序神力，修补紊乱之三界历法，弭平时序浩劫，更解千万载纠缠之夙契因果，以赎前罪。”
“若历劫功成，完此使命，可复归天界，还神位，重掌时序；若历劫不成，执念难消，未能修补历法，则永堕凡尘，魂飞魄散，永绝天地之间！”
旨毕，天道之力骤降，笼罩三神。
何年、何月、何日相视，无半分怨怼，惟存牵挂不舍，与满心愧疚。

The time sequence in heaven is disordered, and the common understanding in mortal world is deep.
Above the nine heavens, there is a divine realm of order, which is eternally silent. There is no replacement of the four seasons, no change of day and night, and no reincarnation of life and old age. Only the laws of time and order of heaven exist, which are used to guide all things in the three realms and determine the flow of time. There is a palace in the domain, named Shixu. It has no beams or pillars, and it towers majestically into the sky. There is a jade jade hanging in the hall, which is pure and clear. It is numbered in the order of time. There are sun, moon and stars rotating on it. The years, months, days and hours move in sequence. The movement of light and shadow corresponds to the changes of the world and the passage of time.
Those who control this divine domain and control the time sequence of the three realms are the three righteous gods of the heaven: the year god, the year god, the moon god, the month, and the sun god, the day.
When the chaos of the three gods first opened, they were transformed by the essence of the time sequence of heaven and earth. They were born in the realm of gods, without father or mother, and depended on each other. They took keeping time and protecting the jade as their vocation. They have gone through thousands of years without any loss. The gods of the three realms say: Although the three gods of the year, month and day are different in nature, their hearts are connected. They control the time and order together, and they are harmonious and seamless. They are the good gods of the heaven.
The god of year, He Nian, is the chief of the three gods, responsible for the change of years, the cycle of seasons, and the passage of time. He has a tall and straight appearance, dressed in plain white robes, and has an eternal aura between his brows and eyes. He is introverted, cautious in words, careful in thought, and meticulous in behavior and behavior. For thousands of years, I have sat and guarded the jade to determine the beginning and end of the years, watching the rise and fall of mortal dynasties and the birth and death of living beings. My heart is like still water, neither happy nor sad, just like the passing of the old years, containing the vicissitudes of the world. In his hand is the year scepter, which is engraved with the heavenly stems and earthly branches. With a light wave, he can determine the age and rotate the reincarnation, which is the most powerful force in the divine realm.
The moon god He Yue, the only female fairy among the three gods, is responsible for the waxing and waning of the moon, the rise and fall of the tide, and the dim light of the night. Her appearance is extremely beautiful, her eyebrows are like distant daisy, and her eyes are like autumn water. She is dressed in a moon-white skirt and surrounded by moonlight. Nature is like the bright moon, with no fixed cloudiness or clearness. It may be gentle and kind, or it may be cold and indifferent, or it may be charming, naive and stubborn. I admire the moonlight in this world, and I often lean on the cloud railing on the side of the palace, overlooking the moonlight fireworks in the world, and yearn for it. However, the rules of heaven are strict, and the God of Time cannot leave his post without permission, cannot interfere with the time order of the world, and cannot have any thoughts of greed for the world. He can only hide his heart inside and dare not let it out. Its shoulders are covered with moonlight silk, which can gather the moonlight and determine the phases of the moon, so that the waxing and waning of the bright moon will be orderly and the night will be peaceful.
Sun God He is the youngest of the three gods, responsible for sunrise and sunset, the change of day and night, and the flow of Yang Qi. The clothes are golden and short brown, the eyebrows are raised, the smile is bright, and the sun shines all over him. His nature is as fierce as fire, straightforward and forthright, like the rising sun, so blazing that it cannot be concealed and does not know how to restrain it. I can't stand the loneliness in the divine realm, so I often want to break through the nine heavens and travel around the three realms, watching the sun rise in the east and setting in the west, and soak in the fireworks of the human world. Every time he was commanded by the Nian God, he would often express his gratitude and then immediately return to his old ways. He was indulged by his brothers and sisters because of his youth, and his nature was out of control. He holds the Sunlight Pearl in his hand, which can attract the scorching sun and stabilize the day, making day and night clear and the Yang Qi flowing smoothly.
For tens of millions of years, the three gods have been doing their own thing: when is the year, when is the month, when is the month, and when is the day? They complement each other and are indispensable. The time sequence of jade is as clear as ever, and the time sequence of the three realms is in order without any disorder. The Jade Emperor and all the gods in the heavens all praised him, saying that he was the most law-abiding and responsible god in the heavens.
Who would have thought that the eternal peace would be shattered in one day?
One day, the sky is clear and clear, and the time is in order. Suddenly, the wind and clouds suddenly change, and the color of the sky and the earth changes.
In the Palace of Time and Order, the usually stable jade biscuit suddenly trembled violently, its pure body suddenly developed ink-colored cracks, the years, months, days, and shadows on the jade were chaotic. The year was wrong, the moon phase was reversed, day and night were confused, and the time sequence of the three realms collapsed instantly.
The mortal world is greatly disturbed by this: when spring is warm, ice and snow suddenly fall; when looking at night, there is no moonlight; when it is daytime, the night is long; there are four seasons in one place, or the years stand still in one place. The mortal beings were in panic, wailing all over the fields, and the anger rising into the sky, alarming the heavens.
The Jade Emperor was furious and immediately led the gods to personally order the divine domain and investigate the source of the chaos.
The immortals concentrated their efforts to investigate, and in a moment they learned that they were the three gods of time and sequence. They had a careless thought, violated the rules of heaven, touched the jade of time and order privately, and disrupted the origin of time and order, causing the three realms to collapse and all living beings to be in ruins.
The day before yesterday, how unbearable was the silence in the divine realm? I saw the common people in the world enjoying the sun and being happy, laughing and chatting loudly, and my heart felt better.Go, then entangle He Yue, wanting to use the jade privately to extend the daylight of the mortal world, so that the people can bathe in the warm sun. He Yue originally had mundane thoughts in his heart, and He asked softly for him, and his mind moved and promised him.
He Chunchu tried his best to stop it, knowing that the laws of heaven could not be violated and the time sequence could not be messed up. However, seeing the eager expectation of his younger siblings, who had thought of guarding the divine realm together for thousands of years without any freedom, his heart finally softened, and he acquiesced without any strict refusal.
When the fingertips of the three gods touched the jade at the same time, the time order of heaven and earth was suddenly disrupted, and the origin of the jade was disturbed. The eternal stable order collapsed, causing a catastrophic disaster.
Although this was not done deliberately by the three gods, due to their own personal affairs and contempt for heaven's rules, this calamity was finally caused, and the blame cannot be evaded.
The Jade Emperor sat upright in the cloud chariot, with a stern look on his face and a majestic voice that echoed through the divine realm: "What year, month, and day are you bold! You three are in charge of the time order of the three realms, shouldering the heavy responsibilities of heaven, and have fulfilled your duties for tens of millions of years. How dare you indulge in your own personal interests, touch the jade privately, mess up the time order of the three realms, harm all living beings, and violate the laws of heaven. Your crime is unpardonable!"
The gods held their breath and no one dared to speak. Among the rules of heaven, time order is the foundation of the three realms. Anyone who messes with time order will be a heinous crime. Even if he is a righteous god, he will not escape heavy punishment.
On what year, what month, and what day, my face turned pale, and before I knelt down to worship the jade, I was filled with regret.
The three of them did not expect that a moment of soft-heartedness and willfulness would lead to such a catastrophe, causing suffering to the people and disrupting the order of the three realms. They regretted it beyond words.
"Your Majesty," He Nian was the first to kowtow, with a steady and ashamed voice, "This crime is all my fault. I am the elder and cannot restrain my younger brothers and sisters. I am soft-hearted and indulgent, causing chaos in the order of time. I am willing to bear the blame and beg Your Majesty to forgive my younger brothers and sisters."
"Brother!" He Ri cried anxiously, his usual arrogance was restrained, and his face was filled with self-blame, "This is not my brother's fault, it's my willfulness. I entangled my sister and touched the jade. The crime is on me. I am willing to be severely punished!"
"Otherwise," He Yue raised her face, the moonlight around her body was chaotic, and her expression was determined, "I first moved on to the worldly thoughts and responded to my brother's request. I share the same crime. I am willing to suffer the same punishment as my brother. No one dares to escape."
The three gods competed to confess their sins and did not want to be alone. Their love for each other for thousands of years is fully displayed here.
The Jade Emperor looked at the three of them with complicated expressions. I know that the three gods are pure in nature and are not treacherous people. They have been lawful and meritorious for thousands of years. This time, they did not do evil intentionally. However, the guilt of the crime is overwhelming. If they are not punished, they will not be able to obey the gods, and they will not be able to appease the wrath of heaven.
After pondering for a long time, the Jade Emperor declared in a deep voice: "The way of heaven is selfless, and rewards and punishments are clear. In any year, month, or day, if you violate the laws of heaven and mess up the time order of the three realms, you should be ruined, fall into the Nine Netherworld, and live forever. I remember that for thousands of years, I have been lawful and meritorious, and I have not deliberately caused chaos. I will be merciful outside the law and be given a lighter sentence."
He paused for a moment, looked solemnly, and determined his punishment: "I hereby decree that the three of you will be deprived of your time-ordered divine status, your immortal magic will be abolished, your spiritual consciousness and memory will be destroyed, and you will be demoted to the reincarnation of the mortal world. You will be reborn in a mortal family as flesh and blood relatives, and you will experience birth, old age, illness, and death, love, hate, anger, and ignorance, and the pain of joy, sorrow, and separation."
"As you are going through a tribulation in this mortal world, you need to recover the divine power of the broken time sequence, repair the chaotic calendar of the three realms, eliminate the catastrophe of the time sequence, and unravel the long-standing cause and effect that has been entangled for thousands of years to atone for your previous sins."
"If the calamity is successful and this mission is completed, you can return to the heaven, return to the throne of God, and regain the control of time; if the calamity is not successful, the obsession is difficult to get rid of, and the calendar cannot be repaired, you will fall into the mortal world forever, your soul will be scattered, and you will never be between heaven and earth!"
After the decree was completed, the power of heaven suddenly dropped and enveloped the three gods.
No matter what year, month or day we looked at each other, there was no trace of resentment, only concern and reluctance, and full of guilt.
